Capability of
producing 200,000,000+
Gallons
We process ethanol with the capability of producing two hundred million gallons of ethanol annually from 66.6 million bushels of corn using a 3.0:1 conversion ratio.
Serving producers
from a
multi-county area
We serve agriculture producers of corn from multi-county areas of Iowa: Allamakee, Bremer, Butler, Cerro Gordo, Chickasaw, Clayton, Fayette, Floyd, Howard, Mitchell, and Winneshiek counties, and Minnesota: Fillmore, Houston, and Mower counties.
Ethanol -
The Alternative
Solution
Ethanol is a renewable fuel made from various plant materials collectively known as “biomass.” More than 95% of U.S. gasoline contains ethanol to oxygenate the fuel and reduce air pollution.
